## Overview

The YugabyteDB receiver collects metrics from YugabyteDB databases using the PostgreSQL wire protocol. It queries system tables and views to gather performance and operational metrics.

## Configuration

| Field              | Description                                      | Default     |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| `endpoint`         | YugabyteDB YSQL endpoint (host:port)             | required    |
| `username`         | Database username                                | required    |
| `password`         | Database password                                | required    |
| `database`         | Database name to connect to                      | `yugabyte`  |
| `collection_interval` | Interval between metric collections           | `10s`       |

### Example Configuration

```yaml
receivers:
  yugabytedb:
    endpoint: localhost:5433
    username: yugabyte
    password: yugabyte
    database: yugabyte
    collection_interval: 10s
```

## Metrics

The receiver collects the following metrics:

| Metric | Description | Type |
|--------|-------------|------|
| `yugabytedb.pg_stat_activity.running_queries` | Number of currently running queries | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.pg_stat_activity.active_connections` | Total active connections | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.pg_stat_activity.query_duration` | Duration of running queries | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.connection.count` | Connections by state and user | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.active_users.count` | Unique active users | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.long_query.count` | Long-running query count | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.long_query.duration` | Long-running query duration | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.query.calls` | Query execution count | Sum |
| `yugabytedb.query.mean_time` | Average query execution time | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.query.total_time` | Total query execution time | Sum |
| `yugabytedb.query.latency.p90` | 90th percentile query latency | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.query.latency.p95` | 95th percentile query latency | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.query.latency.p99` | 99th percentile query latency | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.statement.calls` | Calls by statement type | Sum |
| `yugabytedb.statement.latency.p90` | 90th percentile latency by statement type | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.statement.latency.p95` | 95th percentile latency by statement type | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.statement.latency.p99` | 99th percentile latency by statement type | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.total_qpm` | Total queries per minute | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.tserver.count` | Tablet server count | Gauge |
| `yugabytedb.tserver.status` | Tablet server status | Gauge |

## Resource Attributes

| Attribute | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `yugabytedb.node.host` | Hostname or IP of the YugabyteDB node |
| `yugabytedb.node.cloud` | Cloud provider (gcp, aws, azure) |
| `yugabytedb.node.region` | Cloud region |
| `yugabytedb.node.zone` | Availability zone |
